exercise.title: Open strings, a little faster
exercise.why: The strings are the same distance apart under every chord, so a pick that finds the open strings without a look will find them inside a chord too.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome. Pick each open string four times, down, one note per beat, and follow the tab up and back.
This time watch the tab and not your picking hand. If the pick lands on the wrong string, keep going and catch the next one.
